name: freqtrade-strategies Strategy001
translation_notes: Entry: EMA(20) crosses above EMA(50). The original also requires a green Heikin-Ashi candle closing above EMA(20); Heikin-Ashi is not in the registry, so both HA filters are dropped (more entries than the original). Exit: EMA(50) crosses above EMA(100) - kept as written even though it is odd (a bullish cross used as an exit); the original also requires a red Heikin-Ashi candle closing below EMA(20), dropped. The ROI table (0 min: 5%, 20: 4%, 30: 3%, 60: 1%) becomes a single 5% take-profit. Stop-loss 10% kept; the (disabled) trailing-stop settings are ignored. Timeframe changed 5m -> 1h.
